Name: lilico's Gigi Portrait Edits
Author: lilico
TagLine: 10  new portraits for Gigi's Wizard! Made compatible with LFL.
Description:
#### English
♡ ﻿lilico's gigi hi-res portrait edit (chaekal's wizard ver.) ♡

__initial release: 6/16/2019 version 1.0.0__

CREDIT goes to laixei/gigi for her STUNNING portraits! all i did was edit the young wizard one to make it compatible with wizard romance mods (namely Looking for Love). 

this edit features 9 (10?) new portraits for the wizard in the same style as gigi! i originally edited it for personal use, but i figured i'd share it with others who also enjoy gigi's portrait mod and play with Looking for Love (or other wizard romance mods). i based the expressions of this wizard on the young wizard's portraits present in LfL's files so that it wouldn't have incorrect/wonky expressions when using this alongside LfL! 

**Mandatory mods to use with this one (pick one)**:
[ScaleUp](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3130)
[Portraiture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999)

**Recommended mods to use with this one**:
* [Gigi's Hi-Res Portraits](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3759)
* [Wizard Romanceable Sprite](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3226)
* [Looking for Love](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3054)
* [Romanceable Rasmodius](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073)

#### 한국어
♡ 리리코의 "지지의 Hi-Res의 초상화" 편집 (채칼님의 마법사 ver) ♡

__초기 배포: 16/06/2019 버전 1.0.0__

새 "지지 스타일로" 초상화는 10개 포함됩니다

**설치**

이 모드를 Portraiture 또는 ScaleUp 모드와 사용해주세요 (둘 중 편리한 쪽은 선택하세요)

[CP] lilico's Gigi Portrait Edit은 ScaleUp 모드예요

[Portraiture] lilico's Gigi Portrait Edit은 Portraiture 모드예요


[ScaleUp](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3130)

[Portraiture](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/999)

**추천 모드**

* [결혼확장 마법사 캐릭터](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3226)
* (영어) [Looking for Love](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3054)
* (영어) [Romanceable Rasmodius](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3073)
